GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed sae until 3 Wide @ 550m & Four Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Seven Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & laid in @ 200m. Challenged leaders @ 100m & drew clear late. # Strong last 200m.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped with a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok pressed on to face breeze half off, hung Wide turn, Straightened Up half off, plodded home # faced breeze
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Knuckled shortly after the start. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event. When questioned regarding racing very wide, rdr stated that after settling further forward, her mount was inclined to lay out through the entirety of the event and proved difficult to ride. Rdr was advised that when under pressure in the home straight she must desist on using her whip and straighten her mounts.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 4l off, limited room turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on strong through traffic with limited room # has excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Laid out under pressure rounding the home turn and in the home straight.
